acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks to a guy about a crazy experiment he devised when he was a kid. It almost killed him.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
We begin with a woman whose sister has died. She has questions. Her name is Nadia Bowers, and she wrote this to someone she thinks might be of help.
You can read a shorter print version of Nadia Bowers's story on time.com.
acts.title: Dear Dealer

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: There’s a problem with having a Facebook account after you’re dead that you’ve never, ever, ever thought about. Producer Stephanie Foo tells this story, about Dave Maher.

songs.a: Soul II Soul, featuring Caron Wheeler

acts.title: Commento Mori

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: A guy goes to a funeral for someone he doesn’t know at all, and has to piece together everything about him. Producer Dana Chivvis reports.
acts.title: Funeral for a Stranger
